texte:
NOVEMBER IS LOOKING GOOD FROM UP HERE. 💙✨

Another week, another reason to come upstairs.

Radio sessions, jazz moods, live music and electronic grooves a little something for every kind of night.

And while JAOU takes over the city, Habibi Downtown keeps the nights going. We’re happy to be part of the festival, hosting the official JAOU afters and bringing everyone together, night after night.

Good music, good food, drinks, rooftop views and familiar faces ❤️

🌇 Open from 4PM
🎶 Music from 8PM to 00:30AM
🍴 Food · 🍸 Drinks · 🌃 Rooftop views
✨ Free entry

2–8 November

The festival is on. The rooftop is yours. See you upstairs! 🪩

texte:
S7an Tounsi ce lundi 2 novembre au Habibi Downtown, avenue Habib Bourguiba à Tunis 🇹🇳

Rap tunisien, mezoued passé à l'électro, chants du Nord-Ouest aux synthés, et la pop que toute la salle chante. Tout dans la même assiette, 100% tunisien 🍽️

Portes à 17h, entrée gratuite. Musique de 20h à 00h30 🎧

Une seule date pour ce set. Le lundi suivant, autre thème.
